headline: Hotels.com offers up to 30% off stays with coupon code
summary: Save on hotels and flights with Hotels.com deals and coupons
details: Hotels.com is offering up to 30% off hotel stays for OneKey members, with additional savings on flights and transportation. The deals are available for bookings made through the website.
The website is also offering a coupon code 'SUMMER10' for an extra 10% off select hotels in the US, Canada, or Mexico. To get the discount, bookings must be made by June 8 and stays by August 31.
Hotels.com has a range of deals and sales available, including up to 50% off limited-time deals on select hotels for summer, up to 40% off popular hotels, and hotels under $250.
caption:
Ready to book your summer vacation? Hotels.com has got you covered with up to 30% off stays and more!

Hotels.com is offering up to 30% off hotel stays for OneKey members, with additional savings on flights and transportation. The deals are available for bookings made through the website.

The website is also offering a coupon code 'SUMMER10' for an extra 10% off select hotels in the US, Canada, or Mexico. To get the discount, bookings must be made by June 8 and stays by August 31.

Hotels.com has a range of deals and sales available, including up to 50% off limited-time deals on select hotels for summer, up to 40% off popular hotels, and hotels under $250.
